main_text.l: partibus Germaniæ, & alibi: in libe-ro autem concilio omnia reservari debent legitimæ cognitioni.

8. Canones & decreta con-cilii istius Tridentini si ad scri-pturæ s.normam examinentur, com-perics[?] ea cum prophetarum & apo-stolorū scriptis manifestè, atq; è dia-metro pugnare, & religione Christiana desissimis[?] tenebris involvere: constitutiones item videbis inutiles, ineptas, superstitiosas, & tales quib. homines ad idololatriam & hypo-crisin facile abuti possint. Omitto autem multitudinem cerimoniarum, & similium rerum, quibus puritas doctrinæ Christianæ multis modis obscuratur. Item tyrannica illa; ut omnes & singuli sine examine, sine inquisitione & dijudicatione simpliciter assentiantur nudis concilii decretis: quodque nuda tā-tum ecclesiis decreta obtrudat sine rationibus; & contradicentibus, vel saltem inquirētibus anathema, ferrum & flammam proponat. de quo

page.notes: Left strip shows part of the facing page (show-through or neighbouring page edge), not transcribed. "perics" and "desissimis" are doubtful readings; the long s is printed in a form close to f. The catchword "pro-" is at the lower right.
